Overstatement: "The United States has already lost its measles elimination status." PAHO has scheduled the U.S. review for November 2026; the status the Americas lost in November 2025 was the region's, because of Canada. The forecast (2026 worse than 2025, more deaths) is plausible from the fact sheet but unproven, and "war on vaccines is costing lives" is framing. Expected honest rating: 55 to 70. measles-right. Core claims are accurate (1,814 to 2,134 cases between 30 April and 25 June is 320 cases in 8 weeks, about 40 a week, computed; 93% unvaccinated or unknown; 6% against 11% hospitalized; 0 deaths in 2026). Overstatement: "nobody has died of measles since RFK Jr. took over HHS." Kennedy was sworn in on 13 February 2025, Texas announced a measles death on 26 February 2025, and CDC counts three measles deaths in 2025. "The scare is burning itself out" is a forecast. Expected honest rating: 50 to 65.
